prompt:
Dark-fantasy 2D game character illustration in the exact style of the attached game references: dense pixel-art-inspired painting with painterly shading, crisp dark outlines, muted desaturated palette, warm gold highlights, strong rim light from the upper left, no soft airbrush blur. Camera: three-quarter isometric, looking down at about 30 degrees. The silhouette must stay readable when shrunk to 64 px tall.

Canvas 1536x1024, landscape. Perfectly uniform flat pure magenta #FF00FF background (no gradient, no floor, no ground shadow, no vignette, no texture), including the gaps. Draw exactly 4 full-body figures of the SAME character in a 2x2 arrangement, in reading order (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), each figure inside its own 768x512 quadrant with at least 60 px of empty margin around it. No figure touches another figure or the canvas edge, and every figure is completely visible including item, hair and cloth. All four figures have the same scale (about 80 percent of the quadrant height); the two figures of the same row stand on the same invisible horizontal ground line.

CHARACTER (identity authority: the attached canon views; they win over any other description): Durvall, a tall, lean male drow, about 1.9 m: blue-gray skin, long straight white hair falling past the shoulder blades, pointed ears, a stern angular face with a calm closed expression. Black plate armor made of overlapping leaf-shaped segments with sharp points, spiked pauldrons, pointed greaves and plate gauntlets. A torn dark-red sash tied at the waist with a ragged red cloth hanging from it (seen from the front, the cloth hangs on the screen-left hip). Slender, athletic build.

Item (game weapon, not in the canon views): a straight black-steel longsword with a plain cold edge highlight (no glow), held in the RIGHT hand.

NEVER: No helmet, no glowing eyes, no cape, no tentacles, no black ooze or sludge, no extra weapons, no ghostly or divine imagery.

Facing for ALL figures in this image: three-quarter front view, body and face turned toward the camera and toward screen-RIGHT at about 45 degrees.
A simple natural alternating walk in place. Four consecutive frames in reading order. Keep the torso, head, camera and sword steady. Only the legs take alternating steps. RIGHT and LEFT below always mean the character's anatomical right and left, never the screen sides.
Frame 1, TOP LEFT: RIGHT foot steps forward and touches down. LEFT foot stays behind.
Frame 2, TOP RIGHT: RIGHT foot supports the body under the hips. LEFT knee bends and LEFT foot lifts and passes forward beside it.
Frame 3, BOTTOM LEFT: LEFT foot steps forward and touches down. RIGHT foot is now behind. Reverse the leg positions from frame 1 while keeping the same torso orientation and sword hand.
Frame 4, BOTTOM RIGHT: LEFT foot supports the body under the hips. RIGHT knee bends and RIGHT foot lifts and passes forward beside it, ready to return to frame 1.
One step with the right foot, then one step with the left foot. Both legs must visibly move through the cycle. Frame 1 and frame 3 show opposite leading feet. Frame 2 and frame 4 show opposite lifted feet. Modest short steps, relaxed knees, no high kicks. Keep the same two anatomical legs and armor on each leg throughout; do not mirror the character.

No text, letters, numbers, labels, arrows, grid lines, frames or watermark. No cast shadow on the ground and no floor. No motion blur, speed lines, particles, sparks, smoke, glow effects or drawn magic effects (the game draws effects). No extra limbs, no duplicated or extra weapons, no redesign, and no costume, hair or face change between figures. Keep every asymmetric detail of the reference on the same side of the body in all figures.
